name: Original palace — stair landing and level connections
prompt:
Create ONE clean detailed GAME ASSET REFERENCE SHEET, NOT Blender or a3Dmodel. Plain light ivory studio background, soft even light, full uncropped separate objects, readable thickness, precise non-melting forms. FULL IDs and names outside silhouettes, dimensions marked PROPOSED. Each cell independent illustration scale. No environment scenery, humans, extra unlabeled objects, watermark or whole-palace redesign. Use ONLY the single supplied source image for visible style/material/form authority; infer missing backs and assembly interfaces conservatively. Source illustration motifs are inspiration, not recovered measured geometry. Exactly4 large cells, large three-quarter view for each module plus small front, top and side/contact/section diagram consistent with same geometry. Real open doors/arches/windows must show empty space; no opaque filling where an opening is requested. Continuous unobstructed planar joining ends, separate shells from optional decor, no fused unrelated objects. Hollow roof/room sections show the interior underside and wall thickness. Keep source silhouette, not generic boxes. Title "PAL-TERRACE-STAIR-JOIN-001 — Original palace — stair landing and level connections". Footer "Proposed construction / source-compatible references / mesh joins and views unverified".

Purpose/gap: Missing connections between original stepped wings/roof courts; do not change front fountain/stair layout

PAL-TERRACE-STAIR-JOIN-001-S01 — Straight wing stair landing pair. Dimensions W,D,H [10, 8, 6]m proposed. One isolated straight wing stair landing pair with ivory/rose steps, true flight/landing depth, simple source gold edge profiles, parapet decor removable. Equal proposed risers, clear passage and underside, planar joining faces. No cascade or new main entrance layout.

PAL-TERRACE-STAIR-JOIN-001-S02 — Quarter turn stair landing. Dimensions W,D,H [10, 8, 6]m proposed. Equal proposed risers, clear passage and underside, planar joining faces. No cascade or new main entrance layout.

PAL-TERRACE-STAIR-JOIN-001-S03 — Split terrace stair return. Dimensions W,D,H [10, 8, 6]m proposed. One isolated split terrace stair return with ivory/rose steps, true flight/landing depth, simple source gold edge profiles, parapet decor removable. Equal proposed risers, clear passage and underside, planar joining faces. No cascade or new main entrance layout.

PAL-TERRACE-STAIR-JOIN-001-S04 — Stair to curved terrace threshold. Dimensions W,D,H [10, 8, 6]m proposed. One isolated stair to curved terrace threshold with ivory/rose steps, true flight/landing depth, simple source gold edge profiles, parapet decor removable. Equal proposed risers, clear passage and underside, planar joining faces. No cascade or new main entrance layout.
